description: This file defines command parsing and auto-completion logic for a TUI, including slash commands, command aliases, and command list generation, with external references to command registries, thinking levels, and configuration types.

methods.name: createLevelCompletion
methods.description: Creates a function to generate argument completions based on provided levels.

methods.name: parseCommand
methods.description: Parses input string into command name and arguments, applying alias normalization.

methods.name: getSlashCommands
methods.description: Generates a list of slash commands with auto-completion options, including dynamic commands from configuration.

methods.name: helpText
methods.description: Returns a help string listing all available slash commands and their descriptions.
